resources.string: Temporary local dummy VPN used to release the currently active VPN session after user consent.
VPN permission: not granted. Request permission before running a break.
How long FakeVpnBreaker keeps the temporary dummy VPN active before closing it. Longer values can help Android switch away from the previous VPN more reliably.

This setting controls which traffic Android briefly sends through FakeVpnBreaker. Full takeover routes all device traffic through the temporary VPN, which is usually the most reliable way to release the current VPN. Local only starts a narrower local VPN without the default route; try it if full takeover is not desirable on this device.

This affects only MacroDroid launches that open the TriggerActivity screen. Use that launch method when Android will not start the app from a background action or when the system VPN permission screen must be shown. When enabled, this temporary screen closes itself after starting the VPN break service. Leave it enabled for automation.
Save an importable MacroDroid macro or configure an explicit intent with the shown action and token extra. The token protects the external trigger and is not written to the local log.
